lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here is what I can offer: a full refund or a replacement.
lines.text_cz: Toto vám mohu nabídnout: plnou vrácenou částku nebo náhradu.

lines.text: I'd prefer a replacement, if possible.

lines.text: Of course, and we will send it free of charge with express shipping.
